meta.description.en: Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct is a sparse Mixture-of-Experts vision-language model with about 30B total parameters and about 3B active parameters per token. It supports image understanding, video understanding, multimodal dialogue, and long-context serving.
meta.description.zh: Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct 是 Qwen3-VL 系列的稀疏混合专家视觉语言模型，总参数量约 30B，每个 token 激活约 3B 参数。它支持图像理解、视频理解、多模态对话和长上下文服务。

meta.performance_headline.en: Single-node W8A8 deployment on Ascend 950DT (96 GB × 8)
meta.performance_headline.zh: 在 Ascend 950DT（96 GB × 8）上的单节点 W8A8 部署

overview.en: Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct is a sparse MoE model in the Qwen3-VL family. Its vision-language design supports image understanding, video understanding, and multimodal dialogue while activating about 3B parameters per token.
overview.zh: Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct 是 Qwen3-VL 系列的稀疏 MoE 模型。其视觉语言架构支持图像理解、视频理解和多模态对话，每个 token 激活约 3B 参数。

prerequisites[0].content.en: The W8A8 checkpoint requires one Ascend 950DT node with eight 96 GB NPUs. Download the public ModelScope checkpoint before starting the service.
prerequisites[0].content.zh: W8A8 检查点需要一台配备八张 96 GB NPU 的 Ascend 950DT 节点。启动服务前请下载公开的 ModelScope 检查点。

env_setup.container.A5.content.en:
Pull the public v0.23.0 A5 image and start it with the device and driver mounts from the official tutorial.

```bash
export IMAGE=quay.io/ascend/vllm-ascend:v0.23.0-a5
export NAME=vllm-ascend

docker run --rm \
  --name $NAME \
  --net=host \
  --shm-size=1g \
  --device /dev/davinci0 \
  --device /dev/davinci1 \
  --device /dev/davinci2 \
  --device /dev/davinci3 \
  --device /dev/davinci4 \
  --device /dev/davinci5 \
  --device /dev/davinci6 \
  --device /dev/davinci7 \
  --device /dev/davinci_manager \
  --device /dev/hisi_hdc \
  --device /dev/ummu \
  --device /dev/uburma \
  -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
  -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
  -v /etc/hccl_rootinfo.json:/etc/hccl_rootinfo.json \
  -v /etc/hixlep/:/etc/hixlep/ \
  -v /root/.cache:/root/.cache \
  -v /usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/sbin \
  -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
  -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
  -v /usr/local/sbin/npu-smi:/usr/local/sbin/npu-smi \
  -v /usr/lib64:/usr/lib64 \
  -itd $IMAGE bash
```

scenarios[0].steps[0].content.en:
This A5 single-node scenario runs the quantized checkpoint on eight Ascend 950DT NPUs and accepts image inputs only.

```bash
export VLLM_USE_MODELSCOPE=True
export PYTORCH_NPU_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True
export HCCL_OP_EXPANSION_MODE="AIV"
export HCCL_BUFFSIZE=400
export OMP_PROC_BIND=false
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=100
export TASK_QUEUE_ENABLE=1
export VLLM_ASCEND_ENABLE_FLASHCOMM1=1

vllm serve Eco-Tech/Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct-w8a8-mxfp8 \
  --host 0.0.0.0 \
  --port 8000 \
  --distributed-executor-backend mp \
  --data-parallel-size 1 \
  --tensor-parallel-size 8 \
  --enable-expert-parallel \
  --seed 1024 \
  --quantization ascend \
  --served-model-name qwen3-vl-30b \
  --max-num-seqs 32 \
  --max-model-len 32768 \
  --max-num-batched-tokens 8192 \
  --trust-remote-code \
  --no-enable-prefix-caching \
  --mm-processor-cache-gb 0 \
  --limit-mm-per-prompt.image 1 \
  --limit-mm-per-prompt.video 0 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization {{gpu_memory_utilization}} \
  --compilation-config '{"cudagraph_mode":"FULL_DECODE_ONLY"}'
```

verification.en: The image request above should return HTTP 200 and a JSON response with a `choices` field. The tutorial gives `TONGYI Qwen` as an example of similar generated text.
verification.zh: 上述图像请求应返回 HTTP 200 和包含 `choices` 字段的 JSON 响应。教程以类似 `TONGYI Qwen` 的生成文本为例。

performance.accuracy.en: The official tutorial reports an AISBench result of 0.58 for `mmmu_val` using `acc,none` in generation mode. See [Using AISBench](https://docs.vllm.ai/projects/ascend/en/latest/developer_guide/evaluation/using_ais_bench.html) for the evaluation workflow.
performance.accuracy.zh: 官方教程报告 AISBench 在 `mmmu_val` 上的结果为 0.58，指标为 `acc,none`，模式为 generation。评估流程请参见[使用 AISBench](https://docs.vllm.ai/projects/ascend/zh-cn/latest/developer_guide/evaluation/using_ais_bench.html)。

performance.benchmark.en:
For serving-pipeline validation, run [vLLM benchmark](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/benchmarking/) with the documented command:

```bash
export VLLM_USE_MODELSCOPE=True
vllm bench serve \
  --model Eco-Tech/Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct-w8a8-mxfp8 \
  --served-model-name qwen3-vl-30b \
  --dataset-name random \
  --random-input 200 \
  --num-prompts 200 \
  --request-rate 1 \
  --save-result \
  --result-dir ./
```
performance.benchmark.zh:
对服务流水线进行验证时，使用教程中的 [vLLM benchmark](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/benchmarking/) 命令：

```bash
export VLLM_USE_MODELSCOPE=True
vllm bench serve \
  --model Eco-Tech/Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct-w8a8-mxfp8 \
  --served-model-name qwen3-vl-30b \
  --dataset-name random \
  --random-input 200 \
  --num-prompts 200 \
  --request-rate 1 \
  --save-result \
  --result-dir ./
```

tuning.en: Start with image-only serving. Reduce `--max-model-len`, `--max-num-seqs`, `--max-num-batched-tokens`, or `--gpu-memory-utilization` if startup runs out of memory. Enable video only when needed and tune multimodal prompt limits for the workload.
tuning.zh: 请从图像专用服务开始。如果启动时内存不足，请降低 `--max-model-len`、`--max-num-seqs`、`--max-num-batched-tokens` 或 `--gpu-memory-utilization`。仅在需要时启用视频，并根据实际工作负载调整多模态请求限制。

faq.en: For startup OOM, begin with image-only inputs and video disabled. Prefix caching benefits repeated prefixes; compare it against the baseline for workloads with unique images or random prompts.
faq.zh: 如遇启动 OOM，请从禁用视频的图像专用配置开始。前缀缓存更适合重复前缀；对于图像各不相同或随机 prompt 的工作负载，应与基线配置进行对比。
